mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.waybill_no, o.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.order_status, o.order_source, o.transport_type, o.sender_name, o.sender_phone, o.origin_province, o.origin_city, o.origin_district, o.sender_address, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.destination_province, o.destination_city, o.destination_district, o.receiver_address, o.expect_arrive_time, o.total_fee, (select cgo.cargo_type from tms_order_cargo cgo where cgo.order_id = o.order_id and cgo.is_del = '0' order by cgo.sort_num asc, cgo.cargo_id asc limit 1) as cargo_type_summary, (select ifnull(sum(cgo.quantity), 0) from tms_order_cargo cgo where cgo.order_id = o.order_id and cgo.is_del = '0') as total_quantity, (select ifnull(sum(cgo.weight), 0) from tms_order_cargo cgo where cgo.order_id = o.order_id and cgo.is_del = '0') as total_weight, (select ifnull(sum(cgo.vehicle_count), 0) from tms_order_cargo cgo where cgo.order_id = o.order_id and cgo.is_del = '0') as total_vehicle_count, o.is_del, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from tms_order o left join tms_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.is_del = '0'
mapper.select: select max(order_no) from tms_order where order_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: insert into tms_order( order_no, waybill_no, customer_id, order_status, order_source, transport_type, sender_name, sender_phone, origin_province, origin_city, origin_district, sender_address, receiver_name, receiver_phone, destination_province, destination_city, destination_district, receiver_address, expect_arrive_time, total_fee, remark, is_del, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time )values( #{orderNo}, #{waybillNo}, #{customerId}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderSource}, #{transportType}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhone}, #{originProvince}, #{originCity}, #{originDistrict}, #{senderAddress}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{destinationProvince}, #{destinationCity}, #{destinationDistrict}, #{receiverAddress}, #{expectArriveTime}, 0, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: update tms_order set is_del = '1', update_time = sysdate() where order_id = #{orderId}
